title: The Robot Who Wanted to Dance
author: Hamidreza Rostami
short_description: A practical robot discovers the joy of self-expression through dance.
long_description: Bolt is the best sorting robot in the factory—reliable, precise, and perfect. But when he hears music for the first time, something inside him changes. He wants to dance! But his stiff, practical body isn't made for dancing. With the help of his friend Spark, Bolt learns that being perfect isn't as important as being happy. And sometimes, the best way to sort things out is to let loose and dance. A heartwarming story about self-expression, joy, and breaking free from expectations.

main_characters.name: Bolt
main_characters.description: A boxy silver robot with a round head, glowing blue eyes, and stiff, practical limbs. He has a display screen on his chest.
main_characters.personality: Practical, reliable, determined, learns to be joyful

main_characters.name: Spark
main_characters.description: A small, round maintenance robot with a tool belt, cheerful face, and glowing eyes.

main_characters.name: Foreman Clank
main_characters.description: A large, broad robot with a clipboard and a deep, authoritative voice.
